The Proposal:

For the financial year 2025-26, "Demand No. L-3, Account Head 2515, Other Rural Development Programme, 003-Training, (01) Auxiliary Grant for Training Programme (01) (02) Scheme for Establishment of Joint Training Centre at Gargoti under Shri Mouni University (Compulsory) (25150026) "Joint Training Centre, Gargoti, G. Kolhapur for 31-Auxiliary Grant (Non-Payment) of Rs. 941.00 thousand (Rupees nine lakh forty-one thousand only) and 36 - Rs. 15276.00 thousand (Rupees one crore fifty-two lakh seventy-six thousand only) amounting to a total of Rs. An allocation of 16217.00 thousand (Rupees One Crore Sixty Two Lakh Seventeen Thousand only) has been budgeted. Within the scope of this budget provision, the government was considering disbursement of the third instalment for the purpose of 36 Auxiliary Grants (Salaries).

Government Decision: For this financial year 2025-26, Joint Training Centre, Gargoti, Dist. Kolhapur has been allotted Reference No. 5 Under the Government Decision 36, the following funds have been disbursed for the purpose of Auxiliary Grants (Salaries).
(Amount: In thousands)

2. Now, Government Circular No. Finance-2025 / Q. 44 / Finance-3, D. As per the 07.04.2025 as well as the demand of the training centre concerned, the Joint Training Centre, Gargoti, District Kolhapur, has been allotted 31, Auxiliary Grants (Non-Payment) for the purpose with an outlay of Rs. 5,64,600 - (Rupees Five Lakh Sixty Four Thousand Six Hundred Only) and 36 - Auxiliary Grants (Salary) for this purpose amounting to Rs. 10,69,320 - (Rupees Ten Lakh Seventy-Nine Thousand Three Hundred and Twenty Only) The Government is approving the disbursement of funds as third instalment.

3. Government Circular No. Training-1198 / Q. No. 581/61, No. 23rd September, 1998 and Government Circular, Department of Rural Development and Water Conservation No. Training 2000 / Q. 859/44, D. The Deputy Commissioner (Aastha), Pune Division, Pune, in pursuance of the instructions issued under 12th June 2001, should expeditiously take action regarding payment of monthly subsidy to the training centre. Also the Centre should spend as per the condition in paragraph number 12 of the Government Decision of Reference No. 1.

The Deputy Commissioner (Aastha), Divisional Commissioner's Office concerned shall be responsible for the distribution of the funds and for the strict implementation of the same for which the funds have been sanctioned. Care should also be taken to submit a certificate of utilization of the fund immediately.

5. This cost is "Demand No. L3,2515, Other Rural Development Programmes 31, Auxiliary Grants (Non-Pay) and 36 - Auxiliary Grants (Pay) (25150026) "to be spent under headings and it should be met from the provision made under headings this year. It should also be harmonized to ensure that the expenditure falls under the same index and the Divisional Commissioner should report it to the government every month. The Deputy Commissioner (Establishment) concerned shall act as the Controller of this head of accounts and the Drawing and Disbursing Officer.

6. The Divisional Commissioner's Office shall ensure that the amount of actual grant-in-aid on salary / non-salary basis is made available to the training centre at the time of disbursement of grant-in-aid. Care should be taken to ensure that no more than the above mentioned grants are disbursed. Also, the training centre should give prior intimation to the concerned Commissioner's office as to how much subsidy is required per month for salary / non-payment. Accordingly, the Commissioner's Office shall disburse the grant for salary / non-salary. The principal of the centre concerned will be solely responsible for the necessary grants, if they are not given prior notice.
